nhl-2008-03-27-phx-lak: In the first NHL game recorded in Courtside Archive, the Los Angeles Kings blanked the Phoenix Coyotes 4–0 before 17,331 fans at STAPLES Center. After a scoreless opening period, [[kevin-dallman|Kevin Dallman]] broke through at 6:52 of the second on an assist from [[anze-kopitar|Anže Kopitar]]. Just 2:22 later, Kopitar scored himself, with [[brian-willsie|Brian Willsie]] and [[patrick-o-sullivan|Patrick O'Sullivan]] earning the assists.

The Kings turned the second period into a three-goal burst when [[dustin-brown|Dustin Brown]] converted a power play at 13:03, assisted by [[michael-cammalleri|Michael Cammalleri]] and Kopitar. [[rob-blake|Rob Blake]] added a third-period goal at 11:54, set up by [[alexander-frolov|Alexander Frolov]] and O'Sullivan. Kopitar finished with a goal and two assists and earned the game's official first-star selection.

At the other end, [[erik-ersberg|Erik Ersberg]] stopped all 38 Phoenix shots for the shutout, including 18 in the third period alone. Los Angeles was outshot 38–33 but scored four unanswered goals, giving the archive's lone NHL attendance entry a memorable finish.
